objective: Proof and verification. In a point split of a plane knot space (a plane matching system, with corners as the edges of the line-face graph), the set of port patterns and gluing-line patterns that occur together is decided exactly by heights: fix the line's matched corner, project the height set onto the regions of the ports and the line's points by shortest paths, and test each parity vector by halving the constraints. Verify against enumeration on every point split of the planar census and grown spaces.
status: Proved by HALO-FORCING-20261103-001B-P001: in a point split of a plane knot space the solutions up to complement are the corner matchings (the port lines give double edges; HANDLE-LOCALITY A's matching statement is read with corners as edges), and the transfer between the ports and any line is decided exactly by heights: fix the line's corner, project the difference constraints onto the six regions by shortest paths, and test parities by halving. Verified against enumeration on 71 point splits and 1,221 (split, line) pairs
title: Heights compute the transfer
